Genesis Test Skin — RetroArch overlay
Converted by EmuSkins (https://emuskins.com/retroarch.html).

Install on iOS
  1. Move this whole folder (Genesis_Test_Skin) to Files > On My iPhone > RetroArch > RetroArch > overlays.
  2. In RetroArch: Settings > On-Screen Display > On-Screen Overlay > Overlay Preset > Genesis_Test_Skin/Genesis_Test_Skin.cfg.
  3. Auto-Rotate Overlay (on by default) switches landscape and portrait with the device.
     Set Overlay Opacity to 1.0 if the artwork looks faded.

Other platforms: put the folder in RetroArch's overlays directory (Settings > Directory > Overlays).

Buttons follow Genesis Plus GX / PicoDrive default (A B C on Y B A, X Y Z on L X R, Mode on Select). On another core, remap in Quick Menu > Controls.

Note: No ipad layouts; using iphone.
Note: landscape: no edgeToEdge layout, using standard.
